fee_notes: Fee varies by territory population: $51,950 for up to 100K pop, $64,950 for up to 200K pop, $89,950 for 325K pop, proportionately higher above 325K. Transfer purchases have separate lower fee schedule ($15,950-$49,950).
raw_excerpt: All franchisees that purchase a start-up franchise from us pay an Initial Franchise Fee to us ranging from $51,950.00 to $89,950.00 (amount varies based on size of territory)
